This is the 12th chapter of the [[Pokémon Mezastar: Aim to Be a Tag Master!]] manga. It was first published in the February 2023 issue of ''[[CoroCoro|CoroCoro Ichiban!]]'', released on December 21, 2022.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20240303223024/https://www.bookshop-ps.com/bsp/bsp_magcode?sha=1&sho=1385902123 ''CoroCoro Ichiban!'' February 2023 issue | Shogakukan BOOK SHOP] (Japanese; archived)</ref><ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20221221033819/https://corocoro.jp/news/353943/ ''CoroCoro Ichiban!'' February 2023 issue | CoroCoro Comics] (Japanese; archived)</ref><ref>[https://twitter.com/kemonmon/status/1605516157506621444 Kemon Kawamoto on X (Twitter)] (Japanese)</ref> It is 18 pages long.

It was made available on Weekly CoroCoro Comics on November 27, 2023.
